snippet.title: No Shot VR | Alpha Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
No Shot is a zero gravity VR sports game in development by CircuitLord -- coming from 7 years of VR experience, working on Zenith MMO, Gorilla Tag, and Orion Drift.

STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4177990/No_Shot/
DISCORD: https://discord.gg/GhWPDH65Wr
It is currently in an early alpha state, to sign up for the closed alpha, join the discord!

Music: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uNRX08JOt6c
